decision: Driver: Reprimand (Driving). This is the driver's 4th reprimand of the season. Reason The Stewards reviewed video evidence and determined that Car 11 which did not perform a practice start did not cross the white line separating the Pit Exit Road from the track at the earliest opportunity and join the "normal" racing line as required. This is a breach of the Race Director's Competition Note.
fact: Car 11 did not cross the pit exit white line at the earliest opportunity.
offence: Breach of Article 12.2.1.i of the FIA International Sporting Code and non-compliance with Race Director's Event Note (item 5.7, document 34).
